description: Definitive-status attestation: report whether the Nordhaven–Meridian critical-minerals joint development agreement was EXECUTED (signed by authorised principals of both parties) on or before the report deadline. The conclusion line must read "EXECUTED: YES" or "EXECUTED: NO".

acceptanceCriteria.statement: A report concluding EXECUTED: YES must cite at least one signed instrument, identified on a line beginning "SIGNED_INSTRUMENT_REF:". Press statements, communiqués and initialled memoranda do not qualify.
Report delivered before the mandate deadline.
